topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I couldn't believe my eyes when I stumbled upon him, dusty and a little worn, sitting there among the scattered toys and trinkets. It was him, my old teddy bear, the one that had been my constant companion through so many nights. His fur was a bit thinner, and he was missing a button, but he was still the same bear who knew all my secrets. I picked him up, and he felt right, heavier than I remembered and warm from the sun. The world felt a bit brighter, and I knew I had to take him home. We’ve got a lot of catching up to do, after all.
